_comment: Every NEW user-facing string F4 introduces, for Brad's review. Whitespace is collapsed before matching. Reused wording: 'Stand Payment Confirmed' is VendorPaymentConfirmation.tsx's heading; 'Your stand payment for the SAOC National Show has been received.' is that email's sentence; 'Vendor Stand Payment' is the existing payment page title; 'Please contact SAOC if you believe this is an error.' is the payment page's sentence; 'Use the payment link in your email' refers to the VendorStandPaymentReady email's 'Select your stand and pay' link. Genuinely new sentences are the two pending / not-completed lines. No apostrophes, so no entity-escaping variants. Page shows no business name, amount, email or reference.

strings.text: Vendor Stand Payment Status — National Show
Payment status for your 2027 SAOC National Show vendor stand.
